def: forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity

occurrences.text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
